name: Hell Fire: Seed of Calamity
summary:
It may not seem it, but the world is always held at knifepoint. Anything could trigger the next doomsday...

It is the 370th year of the Third Era of Man. The one known as Grills Arques finally finds the destination he and his father were traveling towards. What he discovers there will lead him and the friends he makes along the way, on a quest to the discover the truth about the world and themselves.
